body.p: Prior to examination on the merits, please enter the present preliminary amendment, wherein the claims have been amended herein to remove multiple dependencies, adjust for antecedent basis, and better conform the claims to US practice. Claims 15-28 are pending, with Claim 15 being independent. Claims 1-14 are canceled and Claims 15-28 are newly added. Applicant respectfully submits that these amendments are supported by the specification as originally filed. Applicant also respectfully submits that no new matter has been introduced by these Amendments.
In view of the foregoing amendments and remarks, Applicant respectfully
submits that the claims of this application are in condition for allowance. Favorable and early consideration of this application is respectfully requested.
Should the Examiner believe that a telephone interview may facilitate
prosecution of this application, the Examiner is respectfully requested to call Applicant's representative at the number indicated below.
Please charge any deficiency as well as any other fees that may become due
under 37 C.F.R. § 1.16 and/or 1.17 at any time during the pendency of this application, or credit any overpayment of such fees, to Deposit Account No. 50-2140.
